name: agent_shell_hooks_parse_response
notes: Shell-hook stdout response parser (shell_hooks_ports.c vs LIVE agent/shell_hooks.py). The C port omits the event parameter and therefore lacks the pre_tool_call 'modify' translation and the pre_verify continue/block rung — inputs hitting those paths are EXCLUDED (documented divergence worth a follow-up port fix). Also excluded: non-string block fields (LIVE type-checks, C's json_get_str yields NULL), whitespace-only context (LIVE strips before truthiness, C does not), numeric-string novita-style payloads n/a here.
